exposure: PoCUS course format (duration, didactic lecture time, practical scanning sessions, learner/tutor ratio)
outcome: Measurement of single deepest pocket of amniotic fluid
Pre- and post-course multiple choice test scores
cohort: The study participants were 55 health professionals with no prior ultrasound experience, including 23 with English as a second language, who undertook PoCUS training.
finding: All participants successfully achieved the limited course objectives taught in the PoCUS courses, regardless of the differences in course formats, duration, and tutor ratios.
